Viper RGB Series DDR4 16GB (2 x 8GB)
                                                         4133MHz Kit w/Black heatshield
                                                         Patriot’s Viper RGB Series memory modules are designed
                                                         with extreme performance. Built and tested for the latest
                                                         Intel and AMD platforms. The bright RGB lighting brings a
                                                         colorful dimension to any build and will take it to the next
                                                         level.

                                                         With a unique aluminum heatshield and aggressive design,
                                                         the Viper RGB Series will look good in any build. The
                                                         aluminum heatshield offers superior heat dissipation to
                                                         ensure excellent performance, even when using demanding
                                                         applications. The 5 RGB lighting zones are all fully
                                                         customizable with our easy to use Viper RGB Software.

                                                         The Viper RGB Series is suited with XMP 2.0 support for
                                                         automatic overclocking and compatible with lead
                                                         motherboard partners’ RGB sync applications. The Viper
                                                         RGB Series DRAM has the most competitive and aggressive
                                                         specifications in the Patriot OC DRAM product lines and is
                                                         available with either a white or black heatshield.

                                                              Introducing the Patriot Signature DDR5 ECC Series, the latest

                                                              Designed for professional computing environments, the Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series delivers dependable DDR5 ECC SODIMM
                                                              performance built for stability and long-term operation.


                                                              ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory is designed to automatically
                                                              detect and correct data errors as they occur, helping to prevent
                                                              system crashes, data corruption, and unexpected downtime. With
                                                              additional ICs dedicated to ECC functionality, these modules
                                                              continuously monitor data transfers between the DRAM module and
                                                              the CPU, correcting errors in real time before they can impact system
                                                              performance or data integrity. This makes the Patriot Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series an ideal solution for mobile workstations and SFF
                                                              server applications where accuracy, reliability, and uptime are critical.


                                                              To ensure proper operation, an ECC-compatible platform is required.
                                                              Consumer-class systems designed for standard non-ECC SODIMM
                                                              memory may not support ECC functionality and may not function
                                                              correctly when ECC SODIMMs are installed.

                                                              Introducing the Patriot Signature DDR5 ECC Series, the latest

                                                              Designed for professional computing environments, the Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series delivers dependable DDR5 ECC SODIMM
                                                              performance built for stability and long-term operation.


                                                              ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory is designed to automatically
                                                              detect and correct data errors as they occur, helping to prevent
                                                              system crashes, data corruption, and unexpected downtime. With
                                                              additional ICs dedicated to ECC functionality, these modules
                                                              continuously monitor data transfers between the DRAM module and
                                                              the CPU, correcting errors in real time before they can impact system
                                                              performance or data integrity. This makes the Patriot Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series an ideal solution for mobile workstations and SFF
                                                              server applications where accuracy, reliability, and uptime are critical.


                                                              To ensure proper operation, an ECC-compatible platform is required.
                                                              Consumer-class systems designed for standard non-ECC SODIMM
                                                              memory may not support ECC functionality and may not function
                                                              correctly when ECC SODIMMs are installed.

                                                              Introducing the Patriot Signature DDR5 ECC Series, the latest

                                                              Designed for professional computing environments, the Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series delivers dependable DDR5 ECC SODIMM
                                                              performance built for stability and long-term operation.


                                                              ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory is designed to automatically
                                                              detect and correct data errors as they occur, helping to prevent
                                                              system crashes, data corruption, and unexpected downtime. With
                                                              additional ICs dedicated to ECC functionality, these modules
                                                              continuously monitor data transfers between the DRAM module and
                                                              the CPU, correcting errors in real time before they can impact system
                                                              performance or data integrity. This makes the Patriot Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series an ideal solution for mobile workstations and SFF
                                                              server applications where accuracy, reliability, and uptime are critical.


                                                              To ensure proper operation, an ECC-compatible platform is required.
                                                              Consumer-class systems designed for standard non-ECC SODIMM
                                                              memory may not support ECC functionality and may not function
                                                              correctly when ECC SODIMMs are installed.

                                                              Introducing the Patriot Signature DDR5 ECC Series, the latest
                                                              memory solution engineered for high performance and reliability.
                                                              Designed for professional computing environments, the Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series delivers dependable DDR5 ECC UDIMM
                                                              performance built for stability and long-term operation.


                                                              ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory is designed to automatically
                                                              detect and correct data errors as they occur, helping to prevent
                                                              system crashes, data corruption, and unexpected downtime. With
                                                              additional ICs dedicated to ECC functionality, these modules
                                                              continuously monitor data transfers between the DRAM module and
                                                              the CPU, correcting errors in real time before they can impact system
                                                              performance or data integrity. This makes the Patriot Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series an ideal solution for workstations and servers
                                                              where accuracy, reliability, and uptime are critical.


                                                              To ensure proper operation, an ECC-compatible platform is required.
                                                              Consumer-class systems designed for standard non-ECC UDIMM
                                                              memory may not support ECC functionality and may not function
                                                              correctly when ECC UDIMMs are installed.

                                                              Introducing the Patriot Signature DDR5 ECC Series, the latest

                                                              Designed for professional computing environments, the Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series delivers dependable DDR5 ECC UDIMM
                                                              performance built for stability and long-term operation.


                                                              ECC (Error-Correcting Code) memory is designed to automatically
                                                              detect and correct data errors as they occur, helping to prevent
                                                              system crashes, data corruption, and unexpected downtime. With
                                                              additional ICs dedicated to ECC functionality, these modules
                                                              continuously monitor data transfers between the DRAM module and
                                                              the CPU, correcting errors in real time before they can impact system
                                                              performance or data integrity. This makes the Patriot Signature
                                                              DDR5 ECC Series an ideal solution for workstations and servers
                                                              where accuracy, reliability, and uptime are critical.


                                                              To ensure proper operation, an ECC-compatible platform is required.
                                                              Consumer-class systems designed for standard non-ECC UDIMM
                                                              memory may not support ECC functionality and may not function
                                                              correctly when ECC UDIMMs are installed.
